sections.theory:
Exercise

1. Four answers are given below for each question. Choose the correct answer.

i. In 1947 the population of Pakistan was — (25 million, 30 million, 33 million, 35 million)

ii. In 1950, at what number was Pakistan in terms of population? (12th, 14th, 16th, 18th)

iii. According to the statistics of 2004 the number of unemployed individuals in Pakistan is — (30 lakh, 32 lakh, 36 lakh, 40 lakh)

iv. According to the statistics of 2014, for how many individuals is there one doctor in Pakistan? (1400, 1073, 1000, 1088)

v. According to the estimates of 2004 Pakistan’s literacy rate is — (40 per cent, 45 per cent, 50 per cent, 54 per cent)

2. Fill in the blanks with suitable words.

1. The total area of Pakistan is ________ square kilometres.

2. At present an annual increase of ________ million individuals is taking place in the population of Pakistan.

3. In 2004 Pakistan came to number ________ in the world in terms of population.

4. ________ per cent of children of primary-school-going age are not admitted to school.

5. According to the estimates of 2004 our literacy rate is ________ per cent.
